questions.stem: Regarding bicarbonate reabsorption along the nephron, which statement correctly describes its quantitative distribution and physiologic significance?

options.text: Approximately 80% is reabsorbed in the proximal tubule, 15% in the thick ascending limb, and 5% in the collecting duct, with virtually none excreted normally.
Approximately 95% is reabsorbed in the proximal tubule by passive basolateral diffusion, and distal nephron reabsorption is physiologically negligible.
Approximately 50% is reabsorbed in the proximal tubule, with the remainder handled equally by the thick ascending limb and collecting duct.
Bicarbonate reabsorption is distributed equally among the proximal tubule, thick ascending limb, and distal nephron.

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Filtered bicarbonate 幾乎全數被回收，其中 proximal tubule 約占 80%，thick ascending limb 約占 15%，collecting duct 處理其餘約 5%。Proximal tubule 主要藉 NHE3、carbonic anhydrase 與 basolateral NBCe1-A 的協同作用完成 bicarbonate reabsorption。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 正確；比例與 Brenner Fig. 9.1 一致。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；proximal tubule 並非回收 95%，且主要機轉不是被動 basolateral diffusion。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；proximal tubule 的占比明顯高於 50%，其餘也不是由兩段平均分配。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；bicarbonate reabsorption 有明顯 segmental distribution，並非平均分布。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 9, Bicarbonate Reabsorption, Fig. 9.1 and Proximal Tubule - General Transport Mechanisms
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 列出約 80%／15%／5% 分布，並說明 NHE3、carbonic anhydrase 與 NBCe1-A。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 優先保留新光交換題 Q4 的題意與 option order；source-provided red answer A 可由 Brenner 直接支持，無版本或 draft 衝突。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (A) aligns perfectly with both NotebookLM responses (A & A). Quantitative distribution of bicarbonate reabsorption is 80% in proximal tubule, 15% in TAL, 5% in collecting duct.

questions.stem: Which statement about renal autoregulation is correct?

options.text: The myogenic mechanism depends on macula densa release of adenosine, ATP, and nitric oxide.
Tubuloglomerular feedback is mediated exclusively by systemic sympathetic input.
The myogenic mechanism is contraction or relaxation of arterial smooth muscle in response to changes in vascular wall tension.
Renal autoregulation primarily requires circulating aldosterone and systemic angiotensin II.

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Myogenic response 是 preglomerular arterial smooth muscle 對 transmural pressure／wall tension 改變的內在反應。Tubuloglomerular feedback 則由 macula densa 感知 tubular NaCl 與 flow，透過 ATP、adenosine 等局部訊號調節 afferent arteriole。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；此敘述把 tubuloglomerular feedback 的 macula densa signaling 誤歸於 myogenic mechanism。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；tubuloglomerular feedback 是 local paracrine mechanism，不是 exclusively systemic sympathetic input。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 正確；這是 Brenner 對 myogenic mechanism 的直接定義。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；Ang II 可調節 autoregulation，但 aldosterone 與 systemic Ang II 不是其必需的 primary regulators。

authorityEvidence.source: 03. The Renal Circulations and Glomerular Filtration.pdf
authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 3, Myogenic and Tubuloglomerular Feedback Mechanisms; Fig. 3.20
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 區分 wall-tension myogenic response 與 macula densa-to-afferent paracrine signaling。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (C) aligns with both NotebookLM responses (C & C). Myogenic response is intrinsic smooth muscle contraction/relaxation in response to vascular wall tension changes.

questions.stem: Which statement about proximal tubular SLC22 transporters is correct?

options.text: OAT1 and OAT3 are basolateral transporters that contribute importantly to renal elimination of drugs and uremic toxins.
OCT2 is an apical urate transporter that secretes urate into the tubular lumen.
OCTN transporters are the principal glucose-reabsorbing proteins in the early proximal tubule.
OAT-like transporters are confined to the collecting duct and do not handle drugs or toxins.

codexExplanation.explanationZh: OAT1 與 OAT3 位於 proximal tubule basolateral membrane，負責由 blood uptake organic anions，涵蓋多種 drugs、metabolites 與 uremic toxins；OCT2 也是 basolateral uptake transporter，但主要處理 organic cations。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 正確；符合 OAT1／OAT3 的膜側位置與 substrate class。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；OCT2 位於 basolateral membrane，處理 organic cations；apical efflux 主要由 MATE family 等完成。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；glucose reabsorption 主要由 SGLT transporters 負責，不是 OCTN。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；OAT family 與 proximal tubular drug／toxin handling 密切相關。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 8, Organic Anion Transporters and Organic Cation Transporters; OAT1 and OAT3; OCT2
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 說明 OAT1／OAT3 與 OCT2 的 basolateral localization、substrates 與 renal elimination roles。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (A) aligns with both NotebookLM responses (A & A). OAT1 and OAT3 are basolateral transporters handling elimination of organic anions, drugs, and uremic toxins.

questions.stem: An older adult has recurrent hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis, volume contraction, urine chloride below 20 mEq/L, and intermittent watery diarrhea. Which mechanism best explains the disorder?

options.text: Constitutive activation of NCC in the distal convoluted tubule
Persistent inhibition of NKCC2 by a loop diuretic
Cortisol-mediated activation of the mineralocorticoid receptor
Reduced intestinal DRA activity causing fecal chloride and proton loss

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Low intestinal DRA activity 會降低 ileal Cl-/HCO3- exchange，使 stool 中 chloride 與 proton loss 增加，形成 volume contraction、hypochloremia、hypokalemia 與 metabolic alkalosis。低 urine chloride 反映 kidney 正在適當保留 chloride。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；NCC activation 會造成 hypertension 與 hyperkalemia，並不符合 volume contraction。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；持續 loop diuretic effect 通常造成較高 urine chloride，且 focus 已否認 diuretic use。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；mineralocorticoid effect 通常伴 hypertension 與 renal chloride wasting pattern。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 正確；此機轉能同時解釋 diarrhea、low urine chloride 與 recurrent hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 16, Unusual Causes of Diarrhea: Villous Adenoma and Congenital Chloridorrhea
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 說明 DRA dysfunction 造成 fecal H+／Cl- loss、ECF contraction 與 hypokalemic alkalosis。

authorityEvidence.source: 24. Interpretation of Electrolyte and Acid-Base Parameters in Blood and Urine.pdf
authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 24, Clinical Approach to Metabolic Alkalosis, Flow Charts 24.12-24.13
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 以 urine chloride 與 volume/BP pattern 區分 etiologies。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 由亞東的 low GI DRA activity 重點與北醫 Q7 改編。北醫個案為 older adult，不能宣稱 genetically confirmed congenital SLC26A3 disease，因此只考 reduced DRA activity／chloride-losing diarrhea mechanism。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (D) aligns with both NotebookLM responses (D & D). Reduced intestinal DRA (SLC26A3) activity causes fecal Cl- and H+ loss leading to hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis with low urine Cl- (<20 mEq/L).

questions.stem: Which statement about urinary diversion is NOT correct?

options.text: Both ileum and colon contain chloride-bicarbonate exchangers that can promote bicarbonate loss.
Hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis is more common after an ileal conduit than after ureterosigmoidostomy.
Potassium secretion together with bicarbonate loss can produce hypokalemic metabolic acidosis.
Prolonged urine transit caused by stasis in a colonic segment increases the risk of this acid-base disorder.

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Ileum 與 colon 暴露於 urine 時，Cl-/HCO3- exchange 會增加 bicarbonate loss，並刺激 potassium secretion，造成 hyperchloremic hypokalemic metabolic acidosis。Ureterosigmoidostomy 因 colonic segment 內 urine transit prolonged by stasis，此 defect 反而較常見，因此 B 的比較方向錯誤。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 正確敘述；Brenner 明列 ileum 與 colon 都具有 Cl-/HCO3- exchangers。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤敘述，也是本題答案；Brenner 指出此 defect 在 ureterosigmoidostomy 特別常見。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 正確敘述；K+ secretion 與 HCO3- loss 共同造成 hyperchloremic hypokalemic metabolic acidosis。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 正確敘述；colonic segment 的 urine stasis 與 prolonged transit time 是 ureterosigmoidostomy 較常發生此 defect 的原因。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 16, Hyperchloremic (Non-Anion Gap) Metabolic Acidoses, ureteral diversion paragraph (primary PDF p.17, printed p.512)
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 逐項支持 ileum／colon 的 Cl-/HCO3- exchange、K+ secretion、hyperchloremic hypokalemic metabolic acidosis，以及 ureterosigmoidostomy 因 colonic urine stasis／prolonged transit time 而較常發生此 defect。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 保留北醫 Q1 的 NOT CORRECT 格式與答案位置 B。原交換題的 stomal obstruction／hyperammonemia、upper urinary tract calculi 與 SLC26A3 naming 無法由指定 Brenner paragraph 逐項直接支持，因此改成 Brenner 同一段可直接驗證的 statements，並標為 adapted。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (B) aligns with both NotebookLM responses (B & B). Ureterosigmoidostomy has longer urine transit time and stasis, making hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis more common than with an ileal conduit.

questions.stem: The renal tissue micrograph shows intraluminal crystal deposits in a dilated collecting duct. The patient has Sjögren syndrome, K 2.8 mEq/L, HCO3 16 mEq/L, urine pH 6.5, and a positive urine anion gap. Which disorder best unifies these findings?

options.text: Enteric hyperoxaluria
Classical distal renal tubular acidosis
Proximal renal tubular acidosis
Type 4 renal tubular acidosis

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Sjögren syndrome、hypokalemic normal-anion-gap metabolic acidosis、urine pH >5.5 與 positive UAG 共同指向 classical distal RTA。此 disorder 的 persistent alkaline urine 與 hypocitraturia 會增加 calcium phosphate nephrolithiasis、nephrocalcinosis 及 collecting-duct intraluminal deposits。影像與此 association 相容，但不能單靠影像判定 crystal composition。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；enteric hyperoxaluria 可造成 calcium oxalate stones，但不解釋 alkaline urine 與 positive UAG 所顯示的 distal acidification defect。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 正確；完整 clinical pattern 指向 classical distal RTA，且 intraluminal crystal deposits 與其 calcium phosphate stone association 相容。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；proximal RTA 在 systemic acidosis 達穩定狀態後通常仍可將 urine pH 降至 <5.5。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；type 4 RTA 通常伴 hyperkalemia，而非本題的 marked hypokalemia。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 16, Hyperchloremic Metabolic Acidoses; Distal Renal Tubule Acidosis; Table 16.9
authorityEvidence.note_zh: positive UAG 代表 low NH4+；Sjögren syndrome 是 classical distal RTA cause，並與 nephrocalcinosis 相關。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 38, calcium phosphate stones and distal renal tubular acidosis
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 支持 alkaline urine 與 distal RTA 的 calcium phosphate stone/crystal association。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 由新光 Q6 改編，移除原題中 UAG 與 UOG 可能形成雙重可接受答案的設計。影像為 Brenner Ch. 38 Fig. 38.6B 的 renal tissue crop，只作為 classical distal RTA 與 calcium phosphate deposition association 的支持線索；不能由影像單獨判定 crystal composition。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (B) aligns with both NotebookLM responses (B & B). Classical distal RTA (Type 1 RTA) associated with Sjögren syndrome features hypokalemic NAGMA, urine pH > 5.5, positive UAG, hypocitraturia, hypercalciuria, and intraluminal calcium phosphate crystal deposits.

questions.stem: A patient treated with ifosfamide has K 2.6 mEq/L, HCO3 15 mEq/L, urine pH 6.5, and a urine anion gap of +26, without glycosuria or phosphate wasting. Which replacement corrects both deficits?

options.text: Sodium bicarbonate alone
Potassium chloride alone
Fluid restriction
Potassium citrate

codexExplanation.explanationZh: 此例為 ifosfamide-associated isolated classical distal RTA：hypokalemic NAGMA、urine pH >5.5 與 positive UAG 顯示 impaired distal acidification 與 low urinary NH4+；缺乏 glycosuria／phosphate wasting 則反對 Fanconi syndrome。Potassium citrate 同時補充 potassium 並提供 metabolizable alkali。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；sodium bicarbonate 可改善 acidosis，但不能直接補足 potassium deficit，且開始 alkali 後須密切監測 K。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；potassium chloride 可補 K，卻不提供修正 chronic acid retention 所需的 alkali。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；fluid restriction 不能治療 distal RTA 的 hypokalemia 或 acidosis。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 正確；potassium citrate 同時提供 potassium 與 alkali，是唯一同時處理兩項 deficit 的選擇。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 16 primary PDF p.17 (printed p.512), UAG discussion
authorityEvidence.note_zh: positive UAG 支持 acidosis 中 urinary NH4+ 不適當地低。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 16 primary PDF p.22 (printed p.517), Table 16.9; p.27 (printed p.522), Table 16.15
authorityEvidence.note_zh: ifosfamide 列為 classical distal RTA cause；classical distal RTA 為 urine pH >5.5、Fanconi lesion absent。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 42 primary PDF p.22 (printed p.1428), Ifosfamide
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 支持 ifosfamide tubular injury 可伴 severe hypokalemia 與 hyperchloremia。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 新光 Q8 的 source-provided red answer A 是 sodium bicarbonate 加 oral potassium citrate。正式題縮短並消除與 potassium chloride option 的重疊，故標為 adapted。Brenner Ch. 16 明列 ifosfamide 亦可造成 classical distal RTA；本題不可被改回 Fanconi syndrome。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (D) aligns with both NotebookLM responses (D & D). Potassium citrate corrects both potassium deficit (hypokalemia) and bicarbonate deficit (metabolic acidosis) without worsening kaliuresis.

questions.stem: How does hyperkalemia promote hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis?

options.text: It stimulates proximal glutamine metabolism and increases ammonium excretion.
It suppresses proximal ammoniagenesis and reduces renal ammonium excretion.
It increases distal bicarbonate secretion without changing ammonium handling.
It increases titratable acid excretion by activating collecting duct proton pumps.

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Hyperkalemia 抑制 proximal tubule ammoniagenesis，並降低 nephron 中 NH4+ transport／recycling 與最終 urinary ammonium excretion。Net acid excretion 因而下降，可形成或加重 hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；這是 hypokalemia 或 acidosis 對 ammonium metabolism 的方向，與 hyperkalemia 相反。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 正確；hyperkalemia 會抑制 ammonium production 與 excretion。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；核心缺陷是 ammonium-mediated net acid excretion 下降，不是 isolated distal bicarbonate secretion。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；hyperkalemia 不會以增加 titratable acid excretion 的方式造成 acidosis。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 16, Fig. 16.3 and Hyperkalemic Renal Tubular Acidosis
authorityEvidence.note_zh: Fig. 16.3 明示 hyperkalemia inhibits ammonium production/excretion。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 17, Renal Consequences of Hyperkalemia
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 說明 potassium loading 降低 ammonia generation 與 urinary NH4+ excretion。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 中榮 item 3 僅提供主題，無 source-provided answer；本題依 Brenner 新寫，未引入範圍外 treatment。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (B) aligns with both NotebookLM responses (B & B). Hyperkalemia causes intracellular alkalinization in proximal tubules inhibiting ammoniagenesis and competes with NH4+ at NKCC2 in TAL, impairing renal ammonium excretion.

questions.stem: Which disorder is characterized by hyperkalemic metabolic acidosis, mild volume expansion, hypertension, suppressed renin and aldosterone, and correction with a thiazide?

options.text: Primary adrenal insufficiency
Pseudohypoaldosteronism type 1
Pseudohypoaldosteronism type 2
Liddle syndrome

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Pseudohypoaldosteronism type 2，又稱 Gordon syndrome／familial hyperkalemic hypertension，源於 WNK pathway 對 NCC 的過度活化。其典型組合是 hypertension、volume expansion、hyperkalemia、mild NAGMA、low renin／aldosterone，並對 thiazide 有良好反應。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；primary adrenal insufficiency 造成 mineralocorticoid deficiency，常伴 volume depletion、hypotension 與 high renin。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；PHA type 1 是 aldosterone resistance／ENaC defect，常見 salt wasting、relative hypotension 及 high renin/high aldosterone。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 正確；題述 phenotype 與 thiazide responsiveness 是 PHA type 2 的典型特徵。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；Liddle syndrome 為 ENaC gain-of-function，造成 hypertension、low renin/aldosterone，但通常是 hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 16, Familial Hyperkalemic Hypertension; PHA-1 paragraphs
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 直接比較 PHA-1 的 salt wasting/high renin-high aldosterone 與 PHA-2 的 low-renin hypertension/thiazide response。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 中榮 item 4 僅列鑑別診斷；本題選擇最具 discriminating value 的 PHA type 2 phenotype，避免把整套分類塞入同一題。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (C) aligns with both NotebookLM responses (C & C). PHA-2 (Gordon syndrome) features gain-of-function NCC activity, leading to mild volume expansion, hypertension, suppressed renin/aldosterone, hyperkalemic metabolic acidosis, and dramatic response to thiazide diuretics.

questions.stem: Why can succinylcholine cause life-threatening hyperkalemia after major burns, denervation, or prolonged immobilization?

options.text: It acutely inhibits aldosterone synthesis and closes epithelial sodium channels.
It blocks Na-K-ATPase selectively in renal tubular cells.
It releases potassium by lysing circulating erythrocytes.
It depolarizes upregulated extrajunctional acetylcholine receptors, producing exaggerated potassium efflux from muscle.

codexExplanation.explanationZh: Burn、denervation、disuse atrophy 與 prolonged immobilization 可使 skeletal muscle AChR 大量 upregulation 並分布到 extrajunctional membrane。Succinylcholine depolarizes 這些 receptor-associated cation channels，造成 exaggerated K efflux。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；此急性 hyperkalemia 不是由 aldosterone synthesis 或 ENaC inhibition 引起。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；主要作用部位是 skeletal muscle AChR，不是 renal tubular Na-K-ATPase。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；不是 in vitro hemolysis 或 erythrocyte lysis 所致。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 正確；AChR upregulation／redistribution 是高風險狀態下 exaggerated K efflux 的核心。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 17, Redistribution and Hyperkalemia, Fig. 17.12
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 說明 upregulated extrajunctional AChR 被 depolarized 後造成 exaggerated K efflux。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 中榮 item 8 指定此機轉；Brenner 另指出 renal failure 本身不等同上述 receptor-upregulation contraindications。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source answer (D) aligns with both NotebookLM responses (D & D). Major burns, denervation, and immobilization induce massive upregulation and redistribution of extrajunctional acetylcholine receptors (including alpha-7 subunits), leading to severe potassium efflux upon succinylcholine administration.

questions.stem: During volume depletion, how does angiotensin II modify intercalated-cell mineralocorticoid receptor signaling to conserve NaCl without markedly increasing potassium secretion?

options.text: It dephosphorylates MR at Ser843, enabling pendrin-dependent electroneutral NaCl absorption.
It phosphorylates MR at Ser843, preventing ligand binding and chloride absorption.
It suppresses pendrin and shifts all sodium absorption to principal-cell ENaC.
It inhibits intercalated-cell MR while directly activating ROMK in principal cells.

codexExplanation.explanationZh: 這是 aldosterone paradox 的一部分。Volume depletion 時 Ang II 促使 intercalated-cell MR Ser843 dephosphorylation，使 MR 可被 ligand 活化並增強 pendrin／NDCBE-mediated electroneutral NaCl absorption；此路徑保留 volume，而不像 ENaC-mediated electrogenic transport 那樣強烈促進 K secretion。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 正確；符合 Ang II、MR Ser843 與 intercalated-cell chloride transport 的方向。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；Ser843 phosphorylation 由 hyperkalemia 促進，會使 MR 無法 ligand binding。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；volume depletion 會增強而非抑制 intercalated-cell pendrin pathway。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；Ang II 的分流不是藉 inhibiting intercalated-cell MR 或直接 activating ROMK。

authorityEvidence.source: 12. Aldosterone and Mineralocorticoid Receptors-Renal and Extrarenal Roles.pdf
authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 12, Separation of Sodium Absorption and Potassium Secretion by the Aldosterone-Sensitive Distal Nephron; Fig. 12.8
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 說明 Ang II 使 MR Ser843 dephosphorylation，啟動 intercalated-cell electroneutral NaCl transport。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 中榮 items 5-6 僅提供 tubular transporter dietary regulation／aldosterone paradox 主題。本題只測一個清楚的 mechanistic distinction，未擴張成完整 pathway inventory。

questions.stem: Which statement best compares osmotic and hemodynamic control of arginine vasopressin secretion?

options.text: Small blood pressure reductions stimulate more AVP release than equal percentage increases in plasma osmolality.
Above its osmotic threshold, AVP rises linearly with small osmolar increases, whereas major volume or pressure loss produces an exponential response.
Osmoreceptor destruction abolishes both osmotic and nonosmotic AVP release.
AVP secretion remains undetectable until plasma osmolality rises by at least 10%.

codexExplanation.explanationZh: AVP 的 osmotic control 非常敏感：超過 threshold 後，plasma osmolality 的小幅上升即造成近似 linear AVP increase。相較之下，5%–10% 的 BP／volume reduction 影響較小，較大的下降才觸發 exponential AVP response。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；正常生理下 osmotic system 對小幅變化更敏感。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 正確；精確描述 osmotic linear response 與 hemodynamic exponential response。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；anterior hypothalamic osmoreceptor damage 可破壞 osmotic response，但 nonosmotic response 可保留。
optionAnalysisZh.D: 錯誤；約 1% 的 osmolality change 已可產生顯著 AVP response。

authorityEvidence.locator: Ch. 15, Osmotic Regulation; Nonosmotic Regulation - Hemodynamic Stimuli; Fig. 15.4
authorityEvidence.note_zh: 比較 threshold-linear osmotic response 與較大 volume/BP loss 的 exponential response。

codexExplanation.sourceNotesZh: 中榮 item 1 無原始 options／answer，本題完全依 Brenner 建立，保持單一 physiological distinction。

questions.reconciliationNotes: Source provided answer (B) is fully concordant with both NotebookLM responses (Index 0: B, Index 1: B). High confidence consensus.

questions.stem: Which finding most strongly predicts failure of fluid restriction in chronic hyponatremia?

options.text: Urine osmolality below 100 mOsm/kg
A 24-hour urine volume above 2.5 L
An increase in serum sodium of 4 mmol/L during the first 24 hours
Urine osmolality above 500 mOsm/kg with urine sodium plus potassium exceeding serum sodium

codexExplanation.explanationZh: High Uosm 表示 AVP effect 強、urine solute-free water excretion 很低；若 urine Na + K 又高於 serum Na，electrolyte-free water clearance 更難形成，因此 fluid restriction 很可能失敗。Brenner Box 15.4 另列 urine volume <1500 mL/day 與 24 小時 Na 上升 <2 mmol/L 為 predictors。

optionAnalysisZh.A: 錯誤；很低 Uosm 代表較佳 free-water excretion，較可能回應 fluid restriction。
optionAnalysisZh.B: 錯誤；低而非高 24-hour urine volume 預測 failure。
optionAnalysisZh.C: 錯誤；24 小時已有 4 mmol/L 上升表示正在回應；failure predictor 是 <2 mmol/L。
